test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Why would the farmers who sowed their crop in June be the worst hit?

options.text: Their crop would already be mature and could rot in the rain.
They sowed their crop in low lying areas.
When they sowed their crop there wasn’t enough rain.
They had sowed a late maturing variety of soyabean.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Their crop would already be mature and could rot in the rain.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's have a look at the first two sentences of the last paragraph of the passage: 

 
 
• *' *On the other hand, longer-duration varieties maturing in 95-105 days, like JS 20-69, NRC 86 and JS 97-52, are unlikely to suffer major yield loss, as their grain is not fully ripe yet for harvesting. Moreover, since the rains were poor in June, much of sowing anyway took place in July, thereby further reducing the likelihood of damage.'
 
• *​*It can be concluded from the above line that* *the farmers who would sow their crop in June be the worst hit because their crop would already be mature and could rot in the rain. (यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि जून में अपनी फसल बोने वाले किसानों को सबसे ज्यादा नुकसान होगा क्योंकि उनकी फसल पहले ही पक चुकी होगी और बारिश में सड़ सकती है।).
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the correct answer is 'Their crop would already be mature and could rot in the rain.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 

 
• The meaning of the word 'mature' is* *fully developed physically; full-grown. ('Mature' शब्द का अर्थ है पूरी तरह से शारीरिक रूप से विकसित; पूर्ण विकसित।).

 
 
• Example:* She was now a **mature** woman.*
